avis.titre: Awesome! But research product before you dive in.
avis.texte: At first, my skin was very upset and erupted in a rash on my cheekbones and breakouts around my mouth and jaw. However, after I started spacing out days I used it so I could adjust my skin now loves it. If you’ve never used retinol, I don’t suggest starting with 1% or you’ll hurt your skin. I’ve been using a weak retinol then moved to this and my skin still freaked out. I suggest starting with CeraVe or something else gentle and working up to a 1%. My skin is looking smoother and it’s helping manage and prevent breakouts, especially on my chest.

Favorite retinol product I’ve tried. I took a couple of weeks building up to using this every night. It fees good and my skin tolerates it well. Other retinol products have upset my skin in the past. Love that there isn’t really a smell and I am noticing a difference after a few weeks. One minor flaw is it’s in a solid plastic container and you have no idea when it’s getting low. This was my first time using a product in this line. I’d try others.

avis.titre: Finally a retinol with no cones..
avis.texte: This is the first retinol I have found that does not have any “cones” or added fragrance, which always break me out. I love that I can add this to my moisturizer or use it alone. My skin is clearer and brighter. All around fabulous product!

I originally started using this product because I wanted something extra to add to my skincare routine that would help with anti-aging. But what this has actually helped with has been hormonal related acne. Ever since I started using this I haven't had any of my usual large under the surface cyst like zits that I used to get around the time of my period that were caused by hormones. I love that this product is so simple and can be added on top of my usual moisturiser. I've been using it for almost 6 months now and I honestly haven't noticed a difference in fine lines or anything else other than the lack of hormonal breakouts, but that's enough of a reason for me to keep using it!

avis.titre: Not sure about the authenticity of this product
avis.texte: Bought my first Boost 1% retinol from Paulas Choice website. Loved it had no adverse reactions. Bought my second one from Amazon & used it as I usually did. The next day or two noticed some peeling & irritation ( some redness)starting. Took bout a week for the peeling to stop. Not sure why this happened? Hopefully this product comes right from the Paulas Choice company? Going to try it on my hand & see what happens.

It actually works! !! I had little hope for getting rid of the large (half-inch) dark sun spots under my eyes but I looked at the mirror today and couldn't believe my eyes the spots are less visible by about 50%! I have been using the cream once a day before bed, and going to continue. I didn't dilute it with a moisturizing cream, just this retinol applied all around my eyes

Can’t see much of a difference YET but this is my first month trying Retinol and so far so good. I can feel the tingling from it so to me I know it’s doing something. I’ll keep you all updated throughout the months
For me, retinol is retinol. But I was disappointed at how fast the bottle ran out. I feel like even for the ounce amount, it ran out way faster than other retinols i’ve used. Would not rebuy.

Zieht schnell ein und ist Geruchsneutral. Ist relativ ergiebig. Sie ist auch geeignet für trockene Haut. Ich benutze sie 2mal in der Woche. Nach dem Auftragen sieht die Haut glatt und straff aus. Einziger Nachteil ist der Preis, da sie nicht so lange hält. Ist aber empfehlenswert.

This is my second time purchasing this booster and I will likely always have it in ny retinol rotation per the very unique and elegant lightweight formulation. Finding actual light gel serums for my combo oily/blemish prone skin has never been easy among as an understatement with any active chemical exfoliant type product. There is much more on the market now than there was even a few years ago but annoying so many actives like retinol are made in endless overly moisturizing lotion/cream serum or night cream similar to how glycolic acid typically always had been prior to the wave of modern liquid exfoliant now. All those options will only breakout and congest blemish prone skin types so finding light formulas takes alot of trial. That is why I started out using retinol serums off Amazon years ago from many smaller unknown brands per the lower gentle percentage among many more light formulas having been available. I was ready to move up to a 1% last year among there being so few on the market with Paula's Choice having had this lightweight formula for my skin type and it just works. What I will never be happy about is the arrogance of the brand raising the prices extremely over the years since the company was bought out (big surprise and change from an affordable brand for the people) including this serum which is insanely overpriced at over $50 for a mere .5 oz so basically over $100 for 1 oz as all serums are sold from every brand and only at this high a price point typicall

avis.titre: Expires 2 months after I received it
avis.texte: This arrived to me in filthy condition, and has a dirty printed out label on it that says it expires two months out! It's obvious this has been laying around and For the price that is just insane. I will not purchase this again.
